definitions.explanation: To follow quickly in order to catch.
To try to achieve or obtain something.

examples.japanese: {犬|いぬ}が{猫|ねこ}を{追|お}った。
{時代|じだい}を{追|お}って{変化|へんか}する。

notes:
{追|お}う means to chase or pursue.

COMMON USES:
- {夢|ゆめ}を{追|お}う: to pursue a dream
- {流行|りゅうこう}を{追|お}う: to follow trends
- {時代|じだい}を{追|お}う: to keep up with the times

COMPOUND VERBS:
- {追|お}い{掛|か}ける: to chase after
- {追|お}い{出|だ}す: to drive out
- {追|お}い{越|こ}す: to overtake
